credit_policy: Each failed witness remains a retained operational negative with zero validation or completion credit. A bounded recovery never erases the failure.

records.failed_witness: An initial broad MEMORY registry search exceeded its output envelope and truncated before a bounded continuity result could be attributed.
records.recovery: Search exact v660-v662 and Ilyra routing keywords in the registry and read only directly relevant line windows.
records.passing_witness: The bounded registry windows identified the sparse-staging, exact-title routing, and one-success-no-replay safeguards without scanning every rollout.
records.recurrence_guard: Begin memory lookup with phase, owner, and route keywords rather than a broad registry dump.
records.rollback: The truncated display changed no state and earned zero memory-read credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Keep continuity lookups narrow and cite only the exact registry ranges used.

records.failed_witness: A PowerShell foreach statement was piped directly into formatting and failed with the Windows PowerShell 5.1 empty-pipe parser error.
records.recovery: Materialize the foreach output into a scalar array before piping it to the formatter.
records.passing_witness: The corrected bounded projection returned the intended memory records.
records.recurrence_guard: Assign foreach output before every downstream PowerShell pipeline.
records.rollback: The parser stopped before any file or Git state changed.
records.sibling_recommendation: Treat statement-to-pipeline syntax as unsupported on Windows PowerShell 5.1.

records.failed_witness: A recursive D-drive worktree discovery remained overbroad and was manually interrupted before attributable completion.
records.recovery: Use the exact source branch name and bounded known worktree root to resolve the Lyren lane.
records.passing_witness: The exact Lyren source worktree was resolved without enumerating sibling content.
records.recurrence_guard: Prefer exact branch and literal-path probes over recursive drive discovery.
records.rollback: The interrupted read-only process changed no state and earned zero discovery credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Never combine broad worktree discovery with source verification.

records.failed_witness: A compound PowerShell ancestry expression had mismatched parentheses and failed before Git returned a result.
records.recovery: Run each merge-base and rev-list probe separately, capture scalar exit codes, and construct the summary afterward.
records.passing_witness: Separate probes proved all anchors ancestral, three single-parent phase commits, and zero merges.
records.recurrence_guard: Keep Git command execution and Boolean aggregation in separate PowerShell statements.
records.rollback: The parser failure occurred before repository mutation and earned zero ancestry credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use simple scalar Git predicates for expected-empty ancestry state.

records.failed_witness: A skill-inventory foreach statement repeated the direct statement-to-pipeline parser fault.
records.recovery: Collect skill path and line-count rows first, then format the completed array.
records.passing_witness: All mandated skills and referenced schemas were inventoried and read completely through EOF.
records.recurrence_guard: Apply the array-materialization guard before every PowerShell foreach projection.
records.rollback: No skill or repository file was changed.
records.sibling_recommendation: Make the parser guard part of startup Method Flow preflight.

records.failed_witness: One 450-line baton window exceeded its output envelope and truncated, so it supplied no complete-read credit.
records.recovery: Reread the affected interval in independent 200-line windows and continue until an empty post-EOF window.
records.passing_witness: The full 3226-content-line, 35885-word committed baton was read through true EOF with the expected SHA-256.
records.recurrence_guard: Use smaller independent windows for long activation files and require an empty post-EOF read.
records.rollback: The truncated window changed no state and remained zero credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Do not infer EOF from a display limit.

records.failed_witness: A combined proposal, builder, and test inspection exceeded the output envelope and truncated.
records.recovery: Read each artifact independently in bounded line windows and inspect only the exact functions needed for the owner delta.
records.passing_witness: Proposal, portfolio, profile, builder, toolkit, test, lifecycle, and manifest contracts were all recovered with attributable reads.
records.recurrence_guard: Give every long code or ledger artifact its own output envelope.
records.rollback: The combined truncated display earned zero code-read credit and changed no state.
records.sibling_recommendation: Do not batch unrelated long source files in one inspection call.

records.failed_witness: The first file-size inventory again piped directly from foreach and hit the Windows PowerShell empty-pipe parser error.
records.recovery: Assign the inventory rows to an array and pipe the materialized result only after the loop completes.
records.passing_witness: The corrected inventory returned exact bytes and line counts for all seven requested Lyren artifacts.
records.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a foreach statement in Windows PowerShell 5.1.
records.rollback: The parser failure stopped before filesystem or Git mutation.
records.sibling_recommendation: Reuse a materialized-array inventory wrapper rather than rewriting the unsafe form.
